metadata.title: Ethereal Monochromatic Portrait with Cursive Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, centered portrait of a woman in a seated pose, rendered in a warm, desaturated sepia palette with a distressed paper texture and a delicate, white hand-written script overlaying the mid-section.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm sepia tones of the subject blend into the off-white textured background.
The white script creates a sharp, bright contrast against the muted skin tones.
The vertical symmetry of the subject is anchored by the horizontal line of the typography.
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused lighting with low contrast
Distressed, weathered paper edges and surface noise

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, full-width subject occupying the vertical axis from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face at the top center and the large-scale script across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face downward to the chest, then following the horizontal flow of the cursive text across the thighs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject fills the frame, but the light background creates a sense of openness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and cream (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep tan and muted brown (shadows and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high-key lighting with compressed dynamic range.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying x-heights and long, flowing ascenders/descenders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'f' features a large, sweeping bottom loop that extends into the next word
The 'L' in the second word is tall and narrow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style script used for all text to maintain a personal, diary-like feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the personal, handwritten quality of the original.
Matches the stroke consistency and airy feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a woman in a warm sepia tone, wearing a light-colored sheer top, seated against a cream-textured background with visible paper grain and distressed edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a single line of white, thin-stroke cursive handwriting across the lower-middle section of the image, ensuring it overlaps the subject's legs and torso.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm-toned and desaturated?
Does the text look like natural, fluid handwriting?
Is the lighting soft enough to minimize harsh shadows?
Is the distressed texture visible on the edges?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text legibility against the skin tones.
Verify the 'weathered' look of the image borders.
Confirm the subject is centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-Focus Portrait + Warm Sepia Palette + Distressed Paper Texture + White Monolinear Cursive Overlay
